# `aitbc agent-task status`

Show escrow state and negotiation progress for a task.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent-task status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--task-id` | text | — | yes | Task identifier |
| `--from-agent` | text | — | no | Buyer agent ID (default: $AGENT_ID or buyer-<hostname>) |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet signing the inbox poll (default: $AITBC_DEFAULT_WALLET) |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--sign`, `--no-sign` | flag | `true` | no | Sign the inbox poll when a wallet is configured |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Agent coordinator URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent-task status --task-id <task_id>
```
